name: yomivox
description: Generates Japanese audio via VOICEVOX and attaches it to your latest Anki card.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp -a public/. dist/
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f yomivox.xpi && cd dist && zip -r ../yomivox.xpi . && cd ..

author: shirubaarison
